prose: The Financial Times excerpt indexed by Techmeme says the ten largest Wall Street IPOs of 2026 traded an average 20.5% below offer prices as enthusiasm for AI weakened. The full article was inaccessible. The precise basket, observation time and averaging method cannot be checked, and an average does not describe every offering or establish a single cause for the declines.
highlights: Figure is an indexed market snapshot
Causal attribution remains the report’s analysis
